name: Saint Pierre and Miquelon

findings.controller: Alcatel Submarine Networks (ASN, France), design-build-maintain contractor
findings.local_actor: Collectivité Territoriale de Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon (contracting authority); Globaltel (operating right)
findings.financier: French State (EUR 5m, digital 'grand emprunt' programme); Caisse des Dépôts (EUR 3m loan)
findings.summary: The Collectivité contracted ASN in March 2016 to design, build and maintain a three-segment submarine fibre loop linking Saint-Pierre, Miquelon and Newfoundland (Fortune, Lamaline); amended to about EUR 11.3m; laid June 2018; Globaltel holds a five-year operating right.

sources.publisher: Journal officiel de Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon (Conseil exécutif délibération 350/2016)
Journal officiel de Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon (Conseil exécutif délibération 293/2017)

findings.analyst_inference: Equipment vendor rule: ASN (French) supplies and maintains the system, coded third, consistent with BLM. Tier 4 not 5: opened sources confirm laying in June 2018 but none states commissioning or current service, so still_current null. Contract value EUR 11,308,825.78 after amendment 2 (gazette); IEDOM cites EUR 12m total; not converted to USD. IEDOM report date not shown on page; 2021 edition. The two gazette deliberations are one authority's records, so independence rests on IEDOM.

findings.summary: AW2S said Globaltel, first 4G operator on the archipelago, was installing its LTE radio equipment at 800 MHz after about 18 months of 1800 MHz trials; IEDOM reports Globaltel's 4G network operational since 2019.
findings.analyst_inference: Vendor attribution rests only on the vendor's own S4 marketing; IEDOM confirms Globaltel 4G operation from 2019 but names no vendor. Tier 4 because the vendor source shows installation starting, not that AW2S equipment carries the whole live network. Whether AW2S is still the RAN/core supplier is unconfirmed. AW2S taken as French (SERMA group); not separately verified this run.

facilities.null_reason: one search found no data-centre or AI-campus project in Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon; results were only open-data and IEDOM economic overviews

silicon.null_reason: no dedicated search; no accelerator purchase or deployment surfaced in other searches

models.null_reason: one combined search on AI/vidéoprotection returned only national French parliamentary material; no provider partnership or sovereign model for the territory

applications.null_reason: one search on vidéoprotection/AI and one on Huawei/ZTE found no Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon surveillance or e-government AI system and no PRC vendor involvement

research_gaps: Confirm the ASN Saint-Pierre/Miquelon/Newfoundland cable was commissioned, is in service, and who operates it after Globaltel's five-year right (from 2016) expired; Canadian onward backhaul provider.
Radio/core vendors of SPM Telecom (Orange-linked) 2G/4G network, and whether Globaltel's AW2S RAN remains in service; any Huawei/ZTE equipment in either network.
Whether France's 2019 5G authorisation regime (anti-Huawei law) has been applied to any Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon sites.
Any Gendarmerie or Collectivité vidéoprotection system and its camera/VMS vendor.
